### Props

| Name            | Type     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `organisations` | `array`  |          | `null`  | Full list of organisations the current user belongs to. When supplied, the badge auto-hides when length &lt;= 1. When unset (length unknown), the badge always renders if an active organisation exists. |
| `size`          | `string` |          | `'sm'`  | Badge size: `'sm'` (default — fits the top-bar) or `'md'`.                                                                                                                                               |
| `fallbackName`  | `string` |          | `''`    | Optional fallback name shown when the active organisation entity has not been resolved yet (only UUID known).                                                                                            |
